Delhi to enforce PUC norms from October 1, fines for non-compliance

Starting October 1, vehicles in Delhi without a valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate will not be provided fuel. A fine of ₹10,000 will be imposed on non-compliant vehicles. The government is also preparing to make PUC centers more effective and reliable, with enforcement drives to monitor vehicles with invalid certificates.
